sources.title: SauerkrautLM-MoEdernColBERT-1.5M-CoreML - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The SauerkrautLM-MoEdernColBERT family introduces MoEdernBERT, a new ModernBERT-style encoder architecture with a mixture of experts and hash embeddings. MoEdernColBERT-1.5M has 1.47M parameters, of which only 0.88M are active per token.

sources.title: SauerkrautLM-MoEdernColBERT: tiny 1.5M-115M MoE… · AGI Hunt
sources.snippet: VAGOsolutions released SauerkrautLM-MoEdernColBERT: 1.5M/27M/115M late-interaction MoE retrievers under Apache 2.0, with GGUF and CoreML builds.

sources.title: SauerkrautLM-Multi-ModernColBERT - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: # SauerkrautLM-Multi-ModernColBERT This model is a multilingual Late Interaction retriever that leverages: Continuous Pretraining with 4.6 billion multilingual tokens using knowledge distillation from state-of-the-art reranker models. GTE-ModernColBERT Foundation building upon the English-focused lightonai/GTE-ModernColBERT-v1 model.

sources.title: VAGOsolutions releases tiny 1.5M-115M MoE… · AGI Hunt
sources.snippet: VAGOsolutions has released the SauerkrautLM-MoEdernColBERT family on Hugging Face — three multilingual multi-vector retrieval models with just 1.5M, 27M, and 115M parameters, open-sourced under Apache 2.0.
